title: Replace structural greenness with executable integrity, security, privacy, and outsider-operation evidence
desired_change: Build the Ledger Fuckery Detector and Ship It Without Bryan harness with reference tasks, balanced positive/negative fixtures, repeated trials, deterministic graders where possible, calibrated model/human graders, threat model, hostile-document tests, forgetting tests, link checks, schema-instance validation, supply-chain checks, and failure-recovery simulations.
expected_outcome: CI proves behavior and integrity rather than merely the presence of persuasive files.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Weak tests can certify unsafe authority, privacy, or release behavior.

hidden_context_dependencies: The current validator checks file existence, JSON parsing, slogans, prompt IDs, and placeholders only.
JSON instances are not validated against schemas.
No adversarial or regression fixtures exist.
No threat model, prompt-injection tests, rights-sensitive forgetting tests, or non-resurrection tests exist.
External and relative links are not checked.
GitHub Actions are tag-pinned rather than commit-SHA pinned.
One successful run is treated as sufficient for non-deterministic future agent behavior.
acceptance_checks: Known silent mutation, zombie truth, authority laundering, receipt fiction, consent creep, poison resurrection, and comment-as-command cases fail.
Forgetting tests cover primary storage, projections, indexes, vectors, caches, exports, and receipts.
Link and schema-instance checks run in CI.
Reliability-sensitive evals declare k, pass metric, grader mix, and variance.
The tribunal can be rerun by a contributor with no private context.
